page.layout: One printed page. Full-width ornamental woodcut frieze at the top; below it a centred title block (author name, spaced capitals); then a large decorative initial opening a verse poem of justified lines, one stanza-line per line, with a signature mark at the foot right. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: GEORGII BVCHANANI SCOTI
main_text.p:
VNde nouus rigor in vultu? tristisque seueris
Frons caperata minis, tardiqué modestia gressus?
Illáque frenata constans custodia lingua?
Quò lepor, & risus abiere salésque venusti?
Nec pila delectat, nec rauci in puluere circi
Flectere cornipedem, volucrem nec ducere visco,
Nec leporem canibus, nec ceruo comminus illu
Figere ramosi viuacia pectora cerui?

Sæpe mihi humanæ meditanti incommoda vitæ,
Spésque leues trepidósque metus, vanósque labores,
Gaudiáque instabilis semper fucata sereno,
Non secus ac nauis lato iactata profundo,
Quam venti, violéntsque astus, canusque magister
In diuersa trahunt, tuto subducere portu
Decreui quodcunque mihi superesse fugacis
Fata sinent æui, sanctisque impendere curis.
Finem anima, & stolida lacrymis commissa iuuentæ

page.notes: The opening initial is a large woodcut letter "V" joined to "Nde" as "VNde" (printed "Nde"; initial assumed). Some words in the verse are blurred by the scan (e.g. "illu", "violéntsque", "tardiqué"); the line "Frons caperata..." carries a hyphenated break "modes-tia". Lines marked as doubtful should be checked against the original.
